degrees_of_freedom.notes: 2 head, 4 per arm (8), 6 per leg (12). No hand/finger DoF listed.

battery.notes: Runtime measured walking at 1.1 m/s; magnetic charging port is optional and supports charging while in use. Real service runtime with standing/talking is not published.

voice_interaction.value: real-time conversation in Chinese or English; voice commands to move, turn, wave, shake hands; selectable personas

sdk.notes: Large-model support, Agent framework, Booster Studio

safety.value: automatic stop on fall/abnormal condition; soft and hard emergency stop; low-battery and overtemperature voice warnings; auto get-up after a fall

hands_grippers.value: none listed (arms have 4 DoF each, no end-effector specified)

payload_kg.notes: No payload rating published; treated as unable to carry anything useful.

ingress_protection.value: not published; assume not water/dust resistant

can.ability: Walk, turn and move sideways on flat indoor floors
can.notes: Up to 2 m/s, turning 1.5 rad/s; actively recovers balance when pushed on uneven ground.

can.ability: Greet and welcome people (wave, head turn)
can.notes: Wave and shake-hands style actions are built in / voice-triggerable.

can.ability: Point or gesture toward a direction or area
can.notes: 4-DoF arms can gesture; precision pointing is approximate.

can.ability: Speak and hold short conversations via speaker and microphone array
can.notes: Chinese and English officially; other languages are an assumption. Noisy rooms will hurt speech recognition.

can.ability: Guide a person to a known spot in the room
can.notes: Walk ahead while talking; requires a mapped, obstacle-free route. Short sessions only (about 70 min walking on the 5 Ah battery).

can.ability: Perform scripted show behaviours (dance, entertain, kid/pet persona)
can.notes: Built-in Agents: Hi Chat, Soccer, Dance, Lion Dance.

can.ability: Observe with camera and report/recognise simple things
can.notes: Stereo camera + large-model support via SDK; accuracy depends on custom development.

cannot.limitation: Carry or serve food, drinks or trays
cannot.notes: No hands/grippers and no payload rating; 95 cm tall, 19.5 kg.
Small humanoid with 60 N·m peak joint torque.

cannot.limitation: Fine manipulation (pressing small buttons, handling cards or cash, using tools)
Wet or dirty work: cleaning, wiping, washing, mopping
cannot.notes: No manipulation capability; no ingress protection published.

cannot.limitation: Climb stairs or cross steps and thresholds reliably
cannot.notes: Not claimed by the manufacturer; only uneven-ground balance recovery.
About 70 min walking per charge; charging needs a magnetic cable connection that it cannot do itself.

cannot.limitation: Reach high or low shelves or counters
Operate safely among crowds or children without supervision
cannot.notes: Can fall; a 19.5 kg robot needs supervised, clear areas.

price_eur.notes: Booster does not publish a price on its site. Third-party listings seen: about $5,999 (Geek, theresanaiforthat.com directory) and about £16,614 incl. tax (Professional, robotshop.com). 8000 EUR is an assumed mid estimate for the Education edition.
